fun_facts: Kayshon Boutte is from New Iberia, Louisiana, and attended Westgate High School.
Kayshon Boutte was rated a four-star recruit.
As a freshman in 2020, Kayshon Boutte caught 14 passes for 308 yards against Ole Miss—a single-game receiving record for LSU.
Kayshon Boutte closed his freshman season with three straight 100-yard games.
In 2025, Kayshon Boutte became the first Patriots player since 2019 to score multiple touchdowns of 25 or more yards in one game.

basis.reasoning: The NFL player profile identifies Kayshon Boutte's college as LSU.

excerpts: And in Sunday's road victory over the Saints, it was Louisiana-born and former Louisiana State receiver [Kayshon Boutte](https://www.espn.com/nfl/player/_/id/4429022/kayshon-boutte) rising up with a clutch performance that included a team-high five catches for 93 yards and 2 touchdowns (deep shots of 25 and 29 yards). Boutte became the first Patriots player to score multiple touchdowns of 25 or more yards in a game since [Phillip Dorsett II](https://www.espn.com/nfl/player/_/id/2579604/phillip-dorsett-ii) in 2019.
